Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion in New Mexico Data Privacy Case

A New Mexico court has ordered Meta to pay a $25 billion penalty after a jury found the company misled consumers regarding data privacy. The ruling is linked to allegations stemming from the Cambridge Analytica scandal, concerning the misuse of Facebook users' personal data. Meta has stated its intention to appeal the decision.
